title: Korean Rice Bowl
description: A hearty, filling bowl filled with Korean-inspired flavors and textures. This dish combines the earthy sweetness of a roasted vegetable with the fluffy goodness of a fried egg, all served atop a bed of steaming hot rice.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
In the pan, scramble the eggs until they are cooked through.
In a separate pan, sauté the mushrooms until they are tender and fragrant.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of cooked rice in a bowl, followed by a fried egg, and finally the sautéed mushrooms.
Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
